FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 152
Committee: Ports, Waterways & Intermodal Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Transit
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/29/2024
Senate Bill 152 as passed the Senate could increase the administrative costs of the State
Pilotage Commission to regulate the usage of maritime data for use in pilotage of vessels. This
bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
